topic: Stronger Sprinklers and fixed early fields
currentUserGoal: Make Tiny Sprinklers easier to obtain and meaningfully stronger so the 2x2 field is reachable, then fix the loose 2x2 layout and accidental click-drag panning.
workCompleted: Reduced the Tiny Sprinkler Memory cost from 5 to 4 Growth and the first run purchase from 10 to 6 Run Touches.
Flattened the Sprinkler copy-cost curve from 1.42x to 1.34x so an early fleet can form much sooner.

Raised each Sprinkler cycle from 1 to 1.5 automated touches, increased its base cadence from 0.48 to 0.65 cycles per second, and increased its direct healing, Care output, Moisture output, Cultivator Growth, and starter Field Growth.

Kept the first field expansion at its meaningful 250 Run Touches price while adding a deterministic Run 2 progression test that reaches 2x2 in about 46.7 seconds with five Sprinklers and remains alive.

Made 1x1 through 5x5 fields compact, centered, and mathematically fixed. A 2x2 desktop board now uses 240-pixel cells with a 216-pixel visual tile and a 24-pixel inter-tile gap instead of fitting tiny art into enormous cells.
Disabled pan and zoom gestures and controls on fixed early fields, committed mouse and touchscreen touches immediately, and prevented stale saved pan and zoom values from shifting an early board.
Preserved pan, zoom, culling, and large-field behavior beginning at 8x8.
verificationRun: npm run check passed after the final changes: ESLint, Knip, 161 Vitest tests across 18 files, strict TypeScript, and the Vite production build.
Focused input, viewport, and ecosystem tests passed with 74 checks.
The deterministic Run 2 expansion simulation reached 2x2 at 46.74 seconds with five Tiny Sprinklers, 98.2 HP, and 192.1 automated touches.
The fixed-field projection test proves 2x2 through 5x5 ignore stale pan and zoom state; 8x8 remains a navigable large field.
Vercel deployment dpl_J6BeD1AWg3h78APeFdnt4wpPRcXq reported Ready and both the production root and playtest route returned HTTP 200.
